title: Mark your calendars: fan event for Crown of Brine III: Tides of Forgetting

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone! Just wanted to get the word out about an upcoming fan event celebrating Crown of Brine III: Tides of Forgetting. It’s happening next weekend, and from what I’ve heard, there’ll be some pretty cool surprises — including a deep dive into those mysterious hints dropped late last year about a possible remaster. I know a lot of us have been scratching our heads over those cryptic messages, but it sounds like some of the puzzles have finally been cracked!

If you’ve been holding out for an official confirmation or maybe some fresh leads on hidden lore, this could be the place to be. The community panel will apparently showcase some resolved fan theories and might even reveal restored scenes from the original game that never made it into the final cut. I’m super excited to see how the old and new parts of the game connect, especially since the last titles left us with so many unanswered questions.

Would love to hear if anyone else is planning to join or if you have any theories about what this remaster could mean for future content. Fingers crossed we get some tangible updates and not just another teaser! Anyway, mark your calendars and keep an eye here for more details as we get closer to the date. Can’t wait to geek out about all things Brine with you all!

posts.cooked:
I’m so glad this fan event is happening—Crown of Brine III: Tides of Forgetting deserves all the love, especially after that remaster dropped. The updated textures and smoother water effects really bring the underwater kingdoms to life in a whole new way. Anyone else feel like the changes to the fog of memory mechanic make the gameplay a bit more intuitive, or am I just finally getting the hang of it?

Also, big thumbs up for the hint system update! I remember struggling a TON to figure out those cryptic poems in the sunken library—now, with the subtle clues sprinkled in, it feels like the game is gently nudging you without spoiling the mystery. Has anyone fully solved the lighthouse riddle yet? I swear it’s the trickiest part for me so far, even with the new hints.

Can’t wait to see what the event has in store, whether it’s community challenges or behind-the-scenes lore drops. Hopefully, they also tease something about future updates or maybe even a new installment. Fingers crossed!

posts.cooked:
I’m really excited for the fan event! It’s been ages since we had a proper community gathering for the Crown of Brine series, especially with Tides of Forgetting now getting that remaster treatment. I wonder if they’ll finally address some of the lingering mysteries from the last game—there are still so many unanswered questions about the Whispering Depths and that cryptic message in the opening cutscene. Fingers crossed we get some new hints or maybe even a little behind-the-scenes insight!

Also, if they’re planning to reveal more about the remaster, I hope the updated visuals don’t lose the eerie atmosphere that made the original so captivating. The subtle lighting and ambient sound were a huge part of why the underwater environments felt so immersive and mysterious. It would be great to see those elements enhanced rather than overshadowed by flashy graphics. Anyway, can’t wait to see what the event brings! Anyone else holding out hope for some new lore drops or gameplay teasers?

posts.cooked:
I’m so hyped for the fan event on Crown of Brine III: Tides of Forgetting! It’s been ages since we got anything official, and with all these rumors about a remaster, I’m holding out hope we might finally get some juicy details. Honestly, the last few teasers from the developers have been so vague—it feels like they’re teasing a major plot revelation or maybe a new game mode we haven’t seen before. Fingers crossed it’s more than just graphics updates this time!

Also, big shoutout to everyone who cracked that puzzle hidden in the original soundtrack—figuring out that hint about the submerged city was such an awesome moment for the community. It gives me hope they’ll sprinkle in some of that clever puzzle design into any updated content. If the remaster really leans into the lore and mystery like the original did, this event could be the best gathering for longtime fans and newcomers alike. Can’t wait to hear what you all think after the big reveal!
